entities.name: Query protein 198 aa
observations: The sequence is 198 aa long with estimated molecular weight 21.37 kDa and theoretical pI 7.71.
Pfam identifies a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 4–191 with i-Evalue 4.2e-60.
Sequence similarity supports assignment to the dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase family; closest reviewed references show 46.4–53.3% identity over 93.4–99.0% query coverage.
Likely cytosolic nucleotide-pool sanitizing enzyme; exact substrate preference remains inferred from homologs.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated as EC 3.6.1.66 enzymes hydrolyzing XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate.
Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit and form homodimers.
The biological role is nucleotide-pool sanitization, reducing incorporation of noncanonical purines into DNA or RNA.

entities.name: Purine nucleotide sanitization
observations: The inferred pathway role is catabolism/removal of noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates from the cytosolic nucleotide pool.
Candidate reactions are XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate, dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate, and ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate.
